mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) signals a weak labor market and economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when UNRATE > 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: Below-average housing starts (HOUST < 500 thousand units) reflect weak consumer demand and economic activity, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when HOUST < 500.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) and high unemployment (UNRATE >= 9.0%) indicate an active monetary policy response to economic weakness, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.2 and UNRATE >= 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-recession recovery phase, a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 10%) signals improving labor market conditions and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods during post-recession recovery when UNRATE < 10%.

mechanism_narrative: Deflationary pressures (CPIAUCSL < 213) indicate weak consumer price growth and economic stagnation, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when CPIAUCSL < 213.

mechanism_narrative: Contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) reflects a weakening manufacturing sector and overall economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Below-trend retail sales (RSAFS < 340,000 million dollars) indicate weak consumer spending and economic demand, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when RSAFS < 340000.
